To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the features used for tumor detection and classification are different from the features used for segmentation of tumor.

the feature extraction methods for the brain tumor segmentation and detection from MR images have been classified into four groups: (a) Texture features; (b) Shape features; (c) Statistical Features; (d) Hybrid features.
the accuracy of the tumor detection and segmentation depends on the features extracted.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of feature extraction techniques used for the purpose of tumor detection and segmentation.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the accuracy of the brain tumor segmentation highly depends upon the features used.
the accuracy of the tumor detection and segmentation highly depends on features used.
, the feature extraction methods used for brain tumor detection are mostly texture based, while for segmentation, the methods used are mostly based on thresholding and region growing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most common features used for brain tumor detection are the first order statistical features, the texture features, and the morphological features.

the methods for feature extraction are classified into two types, namely handcrafted features and learned features, and the methods for feature selection are classified into two categories, namely supervised feature selection and unsupervised feature selection.
the features used for the tumor detection and segmentation are texture, shape, and intensity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the features used for brain tumor detection can be classified as low-level features, mid-level features and high-level features.
there is a wide range of features that can be used for tumor detection and the choice depends on the nature of the dataset.
there is no single best feature extraction technique for the detection and segmentation of tumor.
